name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: PROACTIVE-ONLY BUILD: replaces every reactive/retry design tried since 0.5.0 with three proactive triggers and no retry. (1) New compose window -> unconditional CertVerifier rebuild, well before any send is attempted. (2) Send button/menu, intercepted before the real send starts -> remove a stale cert9.db duplicate only (no reinit), then the original send proceeds exactly once. (3) App shutdown -> remove a stale duplicate. Removing cleanup before this window's only send attempt eliminates the same-window-retry corruption risk (and the need for a fresh nsIMsgComposeSecure/checkRecipientCerts() rewarm) that 0.5.x needed but which kept breaking reading anyway even when it ran and reported success.
